handoffPingPong.definition: consecutive A->B, B->A handoff reversals for one Core and life pair, each no more than 4 ticks apart

homeCarrierNonProgress.definition: during same-team carried possession, count uncontested worlds within 6 static walkable tiles of that team's reactor since the Core last reached a strictly lower distance; allied handoffs and equal-distance movement do not reset the run

stuckCarrier.definition: one Core remains carried by the same life on the same tile for consecutive spectator worlds
